name: splitpage
description: Build, lint and test tooling for Splitpage. The app itself has no runtime dependencies; esbuild builds the bundle, eslint checks every source tree in it (see eslint.config.mjs) and jsdom lends the unit tests a DOM (see build.mjs and src/test/_dom.mjs).

scripts.test:desktop: node desktop/test/drafts.test.mjs && node desktop/test/ipc-table.test.mjs && node desktop/test/blob-store.test.mjs && node desktop/test/history-fs-backend.test.mjs && node desktop/test/prompter-share.test.mjs && node desktop/test/voice-helper.test.mjs && node desktop/test/voice-grace.test.mjs && node desktop/test/google-drive.test.mjs && node desktop/test/spellcheck-menu.test.mjs && node desktop/test/chromium-browsers.test.mjs && node desktop/test/verify-dist-payload.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:tools
